remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(-DENTRY_PREFIX=avifil32_)
spec2def(avifil32.dll avifil32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
add_rpcproxy_files(avifil32.idl)

add_idl_reg_objects(avifil32 registry avifil32.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE nor CONST_VTABLE

# avifil32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/avifil32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(avifil32_shims OBJECT acmstream.c api.c avifile.c editstream.c extrachunk.c factory.c getframe.c icmstream.c tmpfile.c wavfile.c guid.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/avifil32_p.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proxy.dlldata.c)
target_link_libraries(avifil32_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libmsacm32 libmsvfw32 libwinmm libole32 libuser32 libadvapi32 librpcrt4 libucrtbase libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(avifil32_shims)
set(AVIFIL32_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/avifil32/avifil32_r.o)
add_cargo_module(avifil32 avifil32-cargo avifil32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS avifil32_shims psdk avifil32_r ${AVIFIL32_REUSED})
